summary: Five composer follow-ups. (1) The desktop composer's Stop / Queue / Steer / Send text buttons become two 28px round icon buttons, Stop only while a turn runs; the send arrow does the follow-up default mid-turn and its tooltip names both keys. (2) A 'Follow-up while the agent works: Steer / Queue' setting (desktop settings DB key chat.followUpDefault, default Steer; phone prefs per device) decides what Enter does, and Alt/Option+Enter (the phone's chip) does the other. (3) A message the backend holds until the running turn ends is announced (turn.queued / turn.dequeued), listed (provider:list-queued-turns) and can be sent into the running turn now (provider:promote-queued-turn) or taken back (provider:cancel-queued-turn), behind the turn_queue_controls_v1 capability; desktop and phone show it as a dashed Queued bubble with Send now and Cancel. Claude withdraws its priority 'later' message with the SDK's cancelAsyncMessage, Codex splices its queue and promotes with turn/steer, OpenCode can only cancel. The registry releases a cancelled message's outstanding turn, and a promoted one's only where the steer joins the running turn (Codex). (4) The Recents group count is plain grey text. (5) The drift chip gains 'Not in this chat' (per conversation, resolved through resolveRootThreadId), and a chat that has worked in more than two worktrees shows a one-line notice with Turn back on instead. Native Android sends every turn as the provider:submit-user-turn envelope on an atomic_user_turn_v1 backend (positional provider:send-turn otherwise), asks for delivery: 'queue' only where turn_queue_v1 honours it, freezes that choice in the durable outbox (Room v6 adds a nullable outbox.delivery column, so older rows steer as before), keeps the device's follow-up default under Settings > Chat, shows the composer chip that flips it for one send, and marks held rows Queued with Send now and Cancel behind turn_queue_controls_v1.

The Follow chip's 'Not in this chat' and the more-than-two-worktrees notice were not driven in the app; the rule and the storage are unit-tested.

Native Android's composer chip, Queued row, Send now, Cancel and the Settings > Chat choice were not tapped on a device or emulator (none was available); the Room 5 to 6 migration test is instrumented and was compiled, not run.
